significance: An early historic stone temple at 1,337 metres inside the Periyar Tiger Reserve on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border, ascribed to the Chera ruler Chenguttuvan. It opens only once a year for the Chitra Pournami festival, when about 25,000 pilgrims are admitted with the Wildlife Warden's permission, and it stands in territory disputed between the two states.
story: Kannagi, heroine of the Tamil epic Cilappatikaram, is said to have come to this spot after burning down the Pandya capital of Madurai and to have remained here fourteen days.
